text:
Alex: Heads-up: Nuvex wants a joint channel co-sell POC for next Wed (target demo). Goal = embedding search + brief generative summaries over quarterly finance PDFs. They need a run-of-show, network requirements, SSO, and a commercial sketch. Any blockers?

Maria: I can coordinate partner comms and own the runbook. Who is our SE for the demo?

Sam: I'll handle pricing. Need qps and token assumptions to decide Hosted vs Dedicated. Customer mentioned ~15 req/s peak, ~4k tokens/session, ~80 sessions/day as a rough avg.

Jordan: I'll be SE/infra. Question: do they require private networking (VPC peering) or is internet egress to Hosted acceptable for the POC? If VPC, need their CIDR + peering contact + region. Also will need their SAML metadata for SSO.

Priya: Security triage: they submitted our Security Controls Checklist. Initial flags: 1) EU-only data residency for logs/metrics; 2) subcontractor/subprocessor clause they want tightened; 3) MFA enforced via SAML. For VPC peering we'll ask to allow our outbound range 44.55.66.0/24 and expect their on-prem gateway 10.10.0.0/16.

Sam: For a back-of-envelope cost: 15 req/s * 4k tokens = 60k tokens/s peak. With our batching and a quantized model we typically run ~150 qps per A100-equivalent for this shape, so 1 GPU with buffer should be enough for the POC. Dedicated reserve ~1 GPU; order-of-magnitude monthly commit range $1.4k-$2k depending on term. I'll refine once Jordan posts sim.

Jordan: I'll run a quick capacity sim later today and include token spend for 7-day POC (ingest, dev + demo). Provisoning note: pref EU region (eu-west-1 requested). If Hosted, ensure EU-only telemetry config.

OnboardingBot: Runbook created: https://redwood.app/runbooks/1934567000 - steps: 1) create eval env (eu), 2) ingest sample docs, 3) configure SAML SSO, 4) run smoke tests + perf checks, 5) collect logs/artifacts. (autogenerated)

Maria: Reached out to Nuvex eng/legal. They said they will fast-track a 5-doc anonymized sample and SAML metadata by EOD Fri. Also confirmed EU-region preference and a demo window Wed 09:30 CET.

Priya: Legal input required: they want a restriction on subprocessor list updates during the POC. @Legal please advise if we can accept a POC-scoped addendum. Also need confirmation that KMS is used for customer data at rest.

Sam: Finance asks: provide both committed (GPU-hour reserve) and on-demand breakdown in the quote, plus a line item for enterprise support (4-hr escalation during POC). Nuvex requested 99.9% uptime SLA for the demo window.

Jordan: I'm provisioning a non-prod Dedicated eval in eu-west-1 now. ETA ~2.5h for environment + container images. Will push public IPs and a short creds rotation plan once ready. Posting capacity sim and expected GPU-hours in the runbook thread.

Alex: Quick action items: Jordan (infra + sim + GPU/hr), Priya (SCC + legal Qs), Maria (partner comms + sample + SAML), Sam (quote draft). Let's sync tomorrow 10am PT / 18:00 CET. :thumbsup:

Maria: Confirmed 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite with runbook link and include Nuvex contact.

Jordan: Added initial capacity numbers to runbook: Estimated 1 GPU reserved with 25% spike buffer; 7-day POC token estimate ~250M tokens (includes ingestion and demo), GPU-hour estimate ~168 GPU-hours.

Sam: Draft quote coming after I incorporate Jordan's numbers. Will include hosted alternative pricing (per-token) and Dedicated reserved + overage. Also adding priority support option.

Priya: I'll post SCC responses draft by EOD and flag any non-negotiable items. If Legal can't accept the POC addendum, that becomes a blocker.

Alex: Thanks team. If SAML and sample arrive on time and no hard legal blocks, we should be set for the demo next Wed in EU. :rocket:
